environment.execution: Actual LocalGame loader against hand-built old-format synthetic fixtures; detached migration and private-generation restart. No game graphics/server launched.

commands: Window-only ImageMagick import on inherited DISPLAY to dashboard/evidence/structure-offline-legacy-import-cli.png

implementation.versions: Accept offline v3..9 exactly. Version3 has no model table; v4..8 use legacy model library; v9 uses complete world model codec. Terrain generator is present only v7 onward; older files use Terrain.LEGACY_VERSION.
implementation.edits: Use Protocol.Edit.readLegacy for v3/v4, readV7 for v5 and read for v6 onward. Retain old LED default color when no explicit color field exists.
implementation.survival: Inventory and ItemDrop readers use itemFormat=false before v8, preserving old item restrictions. The detached modern metadata envelope preserves validated original values.
implementation.bounds: Unchanged 16 MiB source, 8 MiB model section, 200000 source edits, 100000 final cells, 1024 regions and existing leaf/envelope/metadata budgets. Minimum v3 base file is 93 bytes. Candidate size is checked before returning. No production caps changed.
implementation.publication: Existing private generation stage/restart only. Source files are untouched; no automatic production migration or sidecar handling.

fixture_provenance: Seven hand-built old-format files use existing production inventory/model/drop codecs and the version-appropriate 16/20/24-byte edit prefix. Actual LocalGame constructor provides the loader oracle. Formats3..6 each use implicit terrain1; format7 covers terrain1,2,3. Six existing v8/v9 production-writer fixtures also pass in the regression suite. All files are synthetic and removed; no actual user/account data read.
